diagnostics.message: transition "reject" declares @permission "purchasing.review", but rules.lifecycle.commands is "none": no command is derived from it, so the attribute is never read. Remove it from the transition, or declare it on the command that makes the transition.

transition "withdraw" declares @public: true, but rules.lifecycle.commands is "none": no command is derived from it, so the attribute is never read. Remove it from the transition, or declare it on the command that makes the transition.

operation.command "decide" has no @permission, so it asks the policy about the derived name "acme::purchasing.decide", which changes if the operation is renamed. Declare @permission, or @public: true.

operation.query "requestSummary" has no @permission, so it asks the policy about the derived name "acme::purchasing.requestSummary", which changes if the operation is renamed. Declare @permission, or @public: true.
